label: Fonction linéaire : y = ax + b
code: function linear(x, a, b) { return a * x + b; }

label: Fonction quadratique : y = ax² + bx + c
code: function quadratic(x, a, b, c) { return a * x * x + b * x + c; }

label: Décroissance exponentielle : y = A · e^(-λt)
code: function exponentialDecay(A, lambda, t) { return A * Math.exp(-lambda * t); }

label: Croissance exponentielle : y = A · e^(kt)
code: function exponentialGrowth(A, k, t) { return A * Math.exp(k * t); }

label: Suite de Fibonacci : F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
code: function fibonacci(n) { if (n <= 1) return n; let a = 0, b = 1; for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) { let c = a + b; a = b; b = c; } return b; }

label: Factorielle : n! = n · (n-1) · ... · 1
code: function factorial(n) { let result = 1; for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) { result *= i; } return result; }

label: Distance euclidienne : d = √((x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²)
code: function distance(x1, y1, x2, y2) { const dx = x2 - x1; const dy = y2 - y1; return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); }

label: Produit scalaire : a · b = Σ(aᵢ · bᵢ)
code: function dotProduct(a, b) { let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { sum += a[i] * b[i]; } return sum; }

label: Moyenne arithmétique : μ = (Σxᵢ) / n
code: function mean(arr) { let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { sum += arr[i]; } return sum / arr.length; }

label: Variance : σ² = Σ(xᵢ - μ)² / n
code: function variance(arr) { let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { sum += arr[i]; } const mu = sum / arr.length; let v = 0; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { v += (arr[i] - mu) * (arr[i] - mu); } return v / arr.length; }

label: Intérêt composé : A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
code: function compoundInterest(P, r, n, t) { return P * Math.pow(1 + r / n, n * t); }

label: Intérêt simple : I = P · r · t
code: function simpleInterest(P, r, t) { return P * r * t; }

label: Borne (clamp) : clamp(x, min, max) = min(max(x, min), max)
code: function clamp(x, min, max) { if (x < min) return min; if (x > max) return max; return x; }

label: Interpolation linéaire : lerp(a, b, t) = a + t(b - a)
code: function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + t * (b - a); }

label: Fonction sigmoïde : σ(x) = 1 / (1 + e^(-x))
code: function sigmoid(x) { return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-x)); }

label: Activation ReLU : f(x) = max(0, x)
code: function relu(x) { return x > 0 ? x : 0; }

label: PGCD : algorithme d'Euclide — GCD(a, b)
code: function gcd(a, b) { while (b !== 0) { let t = b; b = a % b; a = t; } return a; }

label: Test de primalité : n est-il premier ?
code: function isPrime(n) { if (n < 2) return false; for (let i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) { if (n % i === 0) return false; } return true; }

label: Recherche binaire : O(log n) dans un tableau trié
code: function binarySearch(arr, target) { let lo = 0, hi = arr.length - 1; while (lo <= hi) { const mid = Math.floor((lo + hi) / 2); if (arr[mid] === target) return mid; if (arr[mid] < target) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1; } return -1; }

label: Normalisation min-max : x' = (x - min) / (max - min)
code: function normalize(x, min, max) { return (x - min) / (max - min); }

label: Conversion température : °F = °C × 9/5 + 32
code: function celsiusToFahrenheit(c) { return c * 9 / 5 + 32; }

label: Aire du cercle : A = π · r²
code: function circleArea(r) { return Math.PI * r * r; }

label: Changement de base logarithmique : log_b(x) = ln(x) / ln(b)
code: function logBase(x, b) { return Math.log(x) / Math.log(b); }

label: Moyenne mobile simple sur les k derniers éléments
code: function movingAverage(arr, k) { const result = []; for (let i = k - 1; i < arr.length; i++) { let sum = 0; for (let j = i - k + 1; j <= i; j++) { sum += arr[j]; } result.push(sum / k); } return result; }

label: Exponentiation rapide : x^n par carré répété
code: function power(x, n) { let result = 1; while (n > 0) { if (n % 2 === 1) result *= x; x *= x; n = Math.floor(n / 2); } return result; }
